evidence.title: muxel v0.4.1 README
evidence.finding: muxel is a native GPUI desktop terminal multiplexer. It documents Linux/macOS/Windows packages, PTY agent panes, Git worktrees, scheduled loops and SSH remote agent execution.

evidence.title: muxel concrete coding-harness presets
evidence.locator: agent.rs AgentPreset constructors, Claude lines 221–222, OpenCode250–251, Pi358–359, Grok409–410, Codex441–442, Antigravity491–492, Gemini518–519; defaults
evidence.finding: The inspected constructors name concrete executable programs claude, opencode, pi, grok, codex, agy and gemini. They are editable terminal-launch presets. Ollama model commands are not counted as additional coding harnesses.

evidence.title: muxel user-facing feature contract
evidence.locator: FEATURES.md Git worktrees lines 768–797, Runners799–817, Loops832–853, Outside control1139–1174
evidence.finding: The documented interface creates worktrees, offers Commit/Merge/Discard/Keep disposal, opens GitHub PR creation via gh, runs saved prompt loops and exposes opt-in JSON outside-control commands to other agents/scripts.

evidence.title: muxel rendered code-diff interface
evidence.finding: The application constructs a visible read-only code editor with the diff grammar and sets its buffer to complete git-diff content, including green additions, red deletions and hunk text. This is an actual content-rendering interface, not only a file-count API.

evidence.title: muxel diff data to the editor
evidence.locator: integrations.rs git_diff lines 2267–2322; app/diff_panes.rs result handling lines 298–300
evidence.finding: git_diff obtains full git diff HEAD output and appends its text to the pane content, with a bounded truncation marker. The inspected app handoff calls editor.set_diff_content(result.text); the visible read-only editor renders that text.

evidence.title: muxel visible diff-pane handoff
evidence.finding: The diff refresh sends full result.text to the existing EditorView through set_diff_content. The documented worktree View changes action opens that diff pane.

evidence.title: muxel GPL license
evidence.locator: LICENSE, GNU General Public License Version3
evidence.finding: The public application repository includes GPL version3. The standard license how-to appendix is not treated as a separate project-specific or-later grant.

evidence.title: muxel dual-licensing scope
evidence.finding: ProjectHax offers the application under GPL-3.0 or a separately purchased commercial license for uses that cannot meet GPL obligations. This is not an Apache/MIT grant.

evidence.title: muxel application and optional Cloud pricing
evidence.locator: Page section muxel cloud, Free forever. Cloud if it helps.
evidence.finding: The public site says all listed desktop features are free with no account. Optional muxel Cloud Individual is displayed as$5/month or$50/year; Team as$15/month for10 people then$1.50 each. The local application is distinct from paid synchronization/team extras. The inspected text uses$ without an explicit currency code.

evidence.title: muxel local app and optional Cloud privacy scope
evidence.finding: The policy says local app projects/terminal/prompts/usage do not go to the vendor, apart from optional Cloud data when signed in. Cloud has separate account/sync/log data and billing. Model/service providers have separate policies. This pass does not establish telemetry controls from a full source audit.

evidence.title: muxel task-control exception at v0.4.1
evidence.locator: FEATURES.md lines 1050–1058, muxel ctl task exception while outside control is off
evidence.finding: The pinned documentation permits a task-linked pane to use ctl task on its task while general outside control is off. It also states that the caller declares its pane ID, so another program running as the same user can name a different task pane. This is a documented limitation, not an independently executed exploit.
